title: Month 3, Week 2 (Jan 10 – Jan 16, 2027): Mature T/NK-Cell, Thymus/Spleen/BM, Inflammatory Skin & Melanoma/SLN Staging

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Write out the Reed-Sternberg (cHL) vs. LP 'Popcorn' Cell (NLPHL) vs. Anaplastic Large Cell (ALCL) IHC comparison table.
Reading (75m): WHO 5th Ed. — Mature T/NK-Cell Neoplasms: ALCL (ALK+ t(2;5) NPM1::ALK hallmark kidney cells, sinusoidal growth, CD30+, EMA+ vs. ALK- [DUSP22 favorable vs. TP63 dismal] vs. Breast Implant-Associated ALCL), Nodal TFH Lymphoma / AITL (arborizing HEVs, CD21+ FDC meshworks, EBV+ B-blasts, ≥2 TFH markers: PD1, ICOS, CXCL13, BCL6, CD10; RHOA/TET2/DNMT3A/IDH2), Extranodal NK/T-Cell (angiocentric necrosis, CD3ε+, CD56+, EBER+), EATL (Celiac, CD103+) vs. MEITL (CD8+, CD56+), & Hepatosplenic T-Cell (γδ TCR+, sinusoidal).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (ALCL hallmark cells, AITL, Extranodal NK/T-cell, EATL, ATLL flower cells HTLV-1).
QBank (30m): 15 T/NK-Cell Lymphoma MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the critical SOE trap: Sinusoidal ALCL Mimicking Metastatic Carcinoma/Melanoma (CD30+, ALK+/-, EMA+, CD43+, often CD3/CD5/CD7 negative!).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall AITL diagnostic triad + TFH markers + IDH2/RHOA/TET2 mutations.
Reading (75m): SCFHS Curriculum Solid Lymphoreticular Organs — Thymus: Thymoma (Types A, AB, B1, B2, B3; p63/p40/CK+ epithelial meshwork + TdT+/CD1a+ immature thymocytes) vs. Thymic Carcinoma (CD5+, CD117+, GLUT1+, lacks TdT+ T-cells) vs. T-LBL (destroys CK+ epithelial meshwork!); Spleen: White pulp vs. Red pulp (Hairy cell, Littoral cell angioma CD31+/CD68+/CD21+); Bone Marrow: Multiple Myeloma (CD138+, CD38+, CD56+, CD19-, CD45-), MPNs (CML, PV, ET, PMF JAK2/CALR/MPL), & Systemic Mastocytosis (KIT D816V, CD117+, Tryptase+, CD25+).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Thymoma B1 vs. T-LBL, Thymic carcinoma, Multiple myeloma, Primary myelofibrosis, Systemic mastocytosis).
QBank (20m): 15 Thymus, Spleen & Bone Marrow MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry on Anterior Mediastinal Core Biopsy: Thymoma B1 vs. T-Lymphoblastic Lymphoma (Pan-CK/p40 epithelial network intact in Thymoma B1 vs. absent in T-LBL!).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out the Anterior Mediastinal Mass differential (Thymoma, Thymic Carcinoma, T-LBL, Primary Mediastinal LBCL, cHL Nodular Sclerosis, Germ Cell Tumor) with key IHC.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Slides: 6 Aggressive Heme/Thymus/Spleen slides (3m/case) + 4 Mediastinal & Lymph Node FNA/Cell Block slides (6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Heme & Mediastinal Cytopathology MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Run the 20m SOE Timer on an Excisional Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy (4-Domain Lymph Node Workup Script from One-Pager 2).

days.b1: Secondary System — Inflammatory Dermatopathology Reaction Patterns (90m): (1) Psoriasiform: Psoriasis (clubbed rete ridges, suprapapillary thinning, Munro microabscesses, hypogranulosis — rule out tinea with PAS!); (2) Spongiotic: Eczema, eosinophilic spongiosis; (3) Interface: Lichen Planus (band-like infiltrate, saw-tooth rete, wedge hypergranulosis, Civatte bodies) vs. Lupus Erythematosus (superficial & deep perivascular/periadnexal infiltrate, follicular plugging, PAS+ thickened BM, Alcian blue+ dermal mucin!); (4) Granulomatous: Granuloma Annulare (necrobiotic collagen + mucin) vs. Necrobiosis Lipoidica (tiered necrobiosis + plasma cells, NO mucin); (5) Panniculitis: Septal (Erythema Nodosum — Miescher radial granulomas) vs. Lobular with vasculitis (Erythema Induratum).
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 15 Inflammatory Skin MCQs + 5 Spot Slides (Psoriasis, Lichen planus, Discoid lupus, Granuloma annulare vs. Necrobiosis lipoidica, Erythema nodosum).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 4 (Inflammatory Dermatopathology Reaction Patterns & Special Stains).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Compare Granuloma Annulare vs. Necrobiosis Lipoidica vs. Rheumatoid Nodule vs. Distal Epithelioid Sarcoma (mucin vs. fibrin, plasma cells, depth, INI1 IHC).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Aggressive Heme/Inflammatory Skin + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Hodgkin, T-Cell Lymphomas, Thymoma & Inflammatory Dermpath).
Deep Review (45m): Audit recall distractors.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Add missed Heme & Inflammatory Skin recall questions to your 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 2 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 2 of Month 3 to GitHub.

days.b1: Deep Dive — Melanocytic Neoplasms, Cutaneous Melanoma Staging & Sentinel Lymph Node Protocol (2.5h): WHO Skin 5th Ed. — Benign Nevi (Maturation/dispersion, Halo, Blue GNAQ/11, Deep Penetrating CTNNB1, Spitz Nevus [Kamino bodies, HRAS or kinase fusions, p16+, PRAME-] vs. Melanoma [PRAME+, p16 loss]); Desmoplastic Melanoma (NF1, S100+, SOX10+, HMB45/Melan-A NEGATIVE!, neurotropism); AJCC 8th Staging: Breslow thickness (granular layer/ulcer base to deepest invasive cell, 0.1 mm), Ulceration, Microsatellitosis (pN1c); & Sentinel Lymph Node (SLN): Capsular Nevus Rest (strictly capsular/trabecular, S100/SOX10/Melan-A/p16+, HMB45-, PRAME-, Ki-67 <1%) vs. Subcapsular/Parenchymal Metastatic Melanoma (HMB45+, PRAME+, Ki-67 high).
days.b2: Slides & QBank (90m): 12 Melanocytic Spot Slides @ 3m/case (Spitz nevus, Blue nevus, Superficial spreading & Nodular melanoma, Desmoplastic melanoma, SLN capsular nevus vs. metastasis) + 25 Melanocytic MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Study One-Pager 3 & record a 3-min spoken SOE response on SLN Capsular Nevus vs. Metastatic Melanoma and Desmoplastic Melanoma vs. Scar.
